+  # `@targets(ex, js)` — restricts the FOLLOWING `mod` to a target set; emits a
+  # DTargets the projection folds into the next module's `targets` (Rian.Decl). The
+  # comma-separated id list reuses parse_typelist.
+  pub def parse_program([TAnnot("targets"), TLP | rest])
+    case parse_typelist(rest) do
+      TL(tgts, rest2) -> [DTargets(tgts) | parse_program(rest2)]
+    end
+  end
   pub def parse_program([_ | rest]) := parse_program(rest)

+  # a `@targets(...)` restricts the following module to a target set (Rian.Decl).
+  defp group([{:d_targets, tgts} | rest]) do
+    case group(rest) do
+      [%Mod{} = m | more] -> [%{m | targets: Enum.map(tgts, &String.to_atom/1)} | more]
+      other -> other
+    end
+  end
